messages:
sara: FYI customer X reporting a spike of 502s to hosted API in eu1 around 17:03 UTC. sample error: "upstream response error: 502".
customer-ops: Seeing ~15% failures during embedding burst, intermittent, not every request.
max: I pulled edge logs — theres an egress queueing pattern when concurrent streams ramp. trace id tr_8d7a1 attached.
lee: Any repro steps we can share with infra?
customer-ops: cURL we used: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
max: thanks. looking at envoy stats: upstream_rq_502 spikes, conn_pool_pending_requests > 400 at peak, and egress_tx_buffered_bytes grows — suggests writers blocked waiting on upstream TLS handshake.
sara: Did anything change in midproxy/egress workers recently?
olivia: We shipped a small midproxy tuning change yesterday to reduce thread count for cost. Reverting now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for job edge/midproxy @1748802090 (initiated by olivia)
max: quick mitigation for affected tenants: enable regional replica fallback and throttle model_shard_concurrency to 2 for embed-heavy clients. That reduces pool pressure.
customer-ops: Applying workaround now, will report back within 5m.
sara: Monitoring dashboards for conn_pool_pending_requests and envoy upstream timing.
customer-ops: After rollback + fallback, 502s dropped to ~0.7% and latency normalized :thumbsup:
lee: Postmortem action items: add egress socket-wait metric to SLO dashboard, add a canary for midproxy thread changes under high-concurrency embed load, and add a short runbook for tenant fallbacks.
max: Filed INF-4821 with traces, heapdump, and timeline. Will follow up with perf regression test results.
